examples.title: Join left and right views
examples.code:
# Combine separate stereo views into one multi-view stream.
join = nuke.createNode("JoinViews")
join.setInput(0, left_view)
join.setInput(1, right_view)

provenance.editorial_note: Assumes the project has left/right views configured.
